600毫米轨距、112根轨枕和148个原生对象构成一座小型采石场。机车停靠、矿晶: A 600-millimeter track gauge, 112 sleepers and 148 native objects form a miniature quarry. The locomotive stops, a mineral crystal drops into a freight wagon, the hook retracts, and the train departs through a stone gantry.
让参数化 CAD 构件成为有清晰装载动作的原创微缩世界，并保留可编辑工程、可复现: Turn parametric CAD components into an original miniature world with a clearly readable loading action, while retaining editable projects, reproducible recipes and evidence of actual application calls.
通过真实 typed DCC-MCP 制作原创窄轨矿场微缩场景。先在 OpenS: Use real typed DCC-MCP to create an original narrow-gauge mining miniature. First write a self-contained parametric source in OpenSCAD and export the rails, sleepers and trestle. Map millimeters to Blender by dividing by 1000, then verify vertices and topology. Create a low-poly rock island, mineral crystals, locomotive, two freight wagons and a crane, using native keyframes at 12fps to show arrival, loading and departure. Set the final arc-length spacing between freight wagons to 2.4m, and check wheel/rail contact, connecting rods, cargo landing positions and gantry clearance. Build a 24fps, 20-second editable timeline in Kdenlive, holding each action image for two frames. Actually reopen and render after migrating the projects, comparing the original renders and every frame of the film. Retain failed approaches, licenses and complete call records.
